horoscopes.horoscope: You will be a compassionate and caring person. Today you are feeling very generous and will give freely of your treasures, which, Ganesha says, will be adequately compensated in future. You have the exceptional ability to combine work and fun, and will treat peers and juniors as your family. Your partner will be with you and never leave you tonight, foresees Ganesha. Being togetherness will intensify your feelings. Sweet, loving words of your partner may make your evening a memorable one, says Ganesha. You can do anything remarkable with your partner just to take this relationship to the next level. The day may start with some sort of irritation. Small small things can bother you. Ganesha also feels that your immunity will be weak today. You should try to have good food. In the later day, you will be much in demand. During the early part of the day, your focus is likely to remain on the matters that are related to house and family members. You will be worried about their routine financial needs. Your mind will remain preoccupied with some family issues until noon. During the latter half of the day, your mind will return to its creative self, and you will be able to negotiate technically complex tasks easily. Eventually, you will decide clearly on the big projects.

There is a chance that your analytical ability will get noticed today by your boss, predicts Ganesha. Such an analytical skill will add to your awareness and wisdom in the afternoon. You might go on a shopping spree to buy cassettes, CDs and similar electronic gadgets, expects Ganesha. Lucky Colour Light Emerald Green Conflicts over small issues may help you feel irritable. You need to play it cool, feels Ganesha. The majority of the problems will be gone if you trust your partner. Take precaution now, otherwise, the situation may get complicated, warns Ganesha. It is felt that today you will require lot of energy. Eat fruits, have light food and go to gym, as you are going to spend lot of energy behind everything on several things. You could fall sick in the later part of day. You shall be too busy in the first half of the day to think about money matters. You will not be in favour of spending money, nor there will be many opportunities to spend much. Today’s astral configuration predicts that you may have a chance to have some fun. This break will surely recharge your batteries. Your creative abilities will be at its best. You will come up with some original ideas today and it will be appreciated, foresees Ganesha.

You will be in a nostalgic frame of mind and will likely revisit old memories from the past. The post noon sessions should see some occurences that will leave you feeling sentimental. You will take decisions guided by your heart rather than your mind. You need to develop a sense of right and wrong, says Ganesha. You may feel shy once your sweetheart dresses up to woo you. Be open and give an honest answer. If you find your partner stunningly appealing, don’t feel shy to admit it. Your sweet compliment may fetch a lot of love in the form of kissing or hugging. Having high expectations but getting involved in thankless jobs may burn your heart. Better to expect less – that’s the best way to remain happy. During second half of the day, you will try to protect or project your ego in front of others. You may lack patience to deal with financial matters. Your speculative nature may come to the forefront and may provoke you to gamble on something or may inspire you to invest in stock market. Your communication skills will be at its peak today. The strong written and verbal communication skill will be put to good use today. Hence, you may spend most of your day in the office either talking to clients, solving complex issues or attending meetings.

Love is not just in the air, it is everywhere. The love bug will bite you so hard that it may make you weep. If you are a part of a long-standing relationship, you will fall in love with your partner all over again. Though you may feel restless in the afternoon for not being able to be with your lover, you will more than make up for the lost time in the evening. If you are a single, you will shower your affection on your partner and overwhelm him/her with your generosity. You may like to dance with your lover or cook a special dish for him/her. Your lover will recognise your sincerity and both will have a romantic evening together. You will be feeling more and more energetic today. During the second half of the day, when logically speaking – you should be tired – astrologically, you are likely to be in full swing. Ganesha feels that today you will invest energy in inspiring others. Today Ganesha advises you to spend money on your beautification, grooming and stuff like that. How about buying new clothes to look flamboyant? Or getting new trendy hairstyle done? Professionally, you will be on cloud nine as your superiors will recommend your name for handling important tasks today. Ganesha thinks this is a good opportunity and you will do well. You’ll be proud to have a diplomatic spouse today.

You need to balance your income and expenditure. It is a good time to invest and speculate in shares. Your debts will be settled, and pending dues will be realised. A work or project that has been delayed for some time, will now be completed. Your relations with your business partners will become stronger now, says Ganesha. Today’s your turn to make the first move. If you find your partner indifferent, it would be your responsibility to arouse his/her mind and you will definitely do something. You need to make sure you don’t hurt your partner, reminds Ganesha. Although the day may not begin on a good note from health angle, planetary transits changing during the second half of the day will actually make your day. Ganesha feels that in the second half of the day, you will have more sense of accomplishment. You will not be in mood to practice economy in case of recurring expenses, nor you would want to control your impulse to buy. It will be wise to look for good deals rather than spending money recklessly. You’ll be low on energy before lunch hour. However, this is a temporary phase and you will pick up your energy in the afternoon. You’ll be active and give your best to achieve maximum results, says Ganesha. Your confidence will be the decider of your fate, says Ganesha.

The place you dwell in could do well with a new look. At least, that is what you want to do today. Add some lively show pieces and sprinkle some of that personality to get the right effect, says Ganesha. In the evening, be prepared to shine out as a master performer and possibly a valuable helping hand. Your love life will take a backseat and your day will be all crisis management. During the latter half of the day, you will be completely occupied with troubleshooting activities. Domestic life may get complicated due to the overburden of responsibilities, feels Ganesha. It’s a good day from health point of view. You will be using your skills very well and will be able to work at greater speed too, to finish off task. You may not feel tired despite working at good pace. Ganesha feels that first half of the day may come up with some good news about money. You will be able to connect with right people for financial gains. This is not ideal time to follow up to recover debts. Though the day will begin on a positive note, you may feel a bit jittery about the way things are going by dusk. You will tend to be analytical and you will give strict focus on your current job. You may receive appreciation from your colleagues for a job well done.

Call it a proof of the old saying, ‘Blood is thicker than water’, but it is your family that will stand you in good stead today, foresees Ganesha. And in keeping with your grateful nature, you are likely to repay your dues later in the day. Don’t be surprised if your rivals admit to your feats — it’s all in the stars today. Your smooth-talking skills and sugary tone will go a long way in stimulating your partner’s interest in you, hints Ganesha. Today is the best day to choose your dream destination if you are planning for a romantic get-together or a honeymoon. Everything will be hunky dory at the love front, predicts Ganesha. The romantic night will be pleasurable and you may like to satisfy your partner. Today, appreciations that you receive from reporting authority will be boosting your morals. In the second half of the day, you might want to plan something with friends or colleagues. However, you should balance between work and home for a smooth day. Stars are in your favour today for getting more work/assignments or business. You are not going to face any financial setback but in the second half of the day, you must avoid investing in speculative market. Today’s planetary configuration is so good that smile on your face will remain the whole day. You will have a satisfying day, and your boss and colleagues will be happy with your day’s report card. Your confidence, creativity, and commitment will grow gradually, feels Ganesha.

The faucet of creativity will run wild today, especially when you try sorting things out with your siblings. Today, you shall bypass all incoming troubles with much ease. Your ingenuity will help you bag a job later, perhaps. In the evening, you will be the Good Samaritan and bring peace to someone, predicts Ganesha. You may be indifferent to your lover’s needs and the relationship may not affect your love life right now but it may create discord later in the week, foresees Ganesha. You need to be extra careful if you want to enjoy a perfectly balanced and harmonious life. In first half of the day, you won’t be resistive to things but in the second half of the day, you might appear to be bit inflexible. You might want to exercise authority in the second half of the day. Think twice before you commit to someone as there are chances of ‘over-committing’ to others in terms of timely delivery of services and or payment. You will be able to address your family’s financial needs. Your spirits may not be high when the day begins, but as the darkness falls, you will be ultra-energetic and determined. Ganesha says that you need to maintain this pace and direction if you want to succeed in life.

Ganesha advises you to flock with birds of the same feather today. The perfection in your ideas may not materialise on paper today. And, it shall be evasive even when you get to the job of executing ideas. But keep working, advises Ganesha, and remain practical later in the day. With things seem to be perfectly well at the workplace, there’s no reason why you should be away from an exciting evening with your lover. You should plan a romantic date to win your desired partner. Your honesty will create a magic at the heart of your soulmate. As the day progresses, you will feel favoured by luck, your mood will change for the better and you will be able to give better output. You will be able to finish more pending tasks, by the grace of Ganesha. The day looks good for opening joint account with life partner or business partner. You may also think about buying an asset jointly. Ganesha advises you to think deeply about such decisions instead of rushing in. Some system error may occupy the most of your time in the office today. It will only be in the evening when you will get relief and stretch your legs. The complex calculation will appear like a child’s play, feels Ganesha.

Emotions are difficult to understand for you, especially of your lover. He/she will be more open and expressive today, and it’ll help you both understand your relationship better. Also, spend some quality time with each other and strengthen you bond by giving him/her a pleasant surprise or a gift, suggests Ganesha. Your loved one may tell you today that you aren’t spending quality time with him/her. Do something really sweet to appease your partner, says Ganesha. Keeping in touch with your sweetheart or a romantic surprise over a phone will bring both of you closer to each other. In the first half of the day, opposite sex may draw your attention However, you will have to beware of emotional bombarding from the other end, as it might affect your mood. Your health may not be good in the later part of the day. You should try to create your own balance-sheet of the past few months. This will surely help figure out where day to day expenses are increasing and how you can cut them down. You are on a mission to achieve results but the day starts with clouds of confusion. When it comes to your work, it will be ideal to convince others and approach with a logical mind. Be patient and you will reap benefits.

If embroiled in a litigation, it is advisable that you settle out of court. Your resilience carries you through tough times. But your conviction and courage is often misunderstood for rigidity. Soften your attitude, suggests Ganesha, if you want to prove others wrong. You should feel concerned about your loved one as he/she may be detached. Adore your sweetheart in such a way that he or she forgets all the tensions and enjoys the maximum pleasure in the arms of you with heart’s content, suggests Ganesha. While the first part of the day may find you irritated, towards second half of the day, you may remain in demand and you will have to pay attention to many things, feels Ganesha. Do not let incomplete tasks bother you. Ganesha advises you not to spend money on credit card today as there are more chances of delay in repayment, if you do so. You may need to think deeply and broadly about personal finances. Current planetary alignment demands extra efforts from you. You don’t need to be too much emotional about work. You should help your colleagues get inspired by you rather than being jealous, says Ganesha. Avoid carrying any tension back home as it will trouble your mind.

You will find yourself in a nostalgic frame of mind today, and will attempt to reach out to long lost friends and relatives, says Ganesha. It is also a good day for social and religious activities. You will also relate to your work rather emotionally. However, when it comes to business, practical prudence should guide your decisions rather than emotional attachments, opines Ganesha. You won’t be disappointed if you seek comfort in the arms of your loved one, assures Ganesha. You may like to bring your best outlook in front of your lover. However, your sweetheart will melt in your words and not in your appearance, feels Ganesha. Your enthusiasm level can get affected in the second half of the day as your expectations from others will be very high. You should take very good care of health during the second half of the day as there are all chances of falling sick. As the day moves forward, day to day expenses may start bothering you. Ganesha suggests you to avoid spending money based on impulse and be more calculative. Follow your mind and not your heart. With the number of files you have accumulated in your pending folder, you won’t get a minute to yourself. You will be having busy hours in front of computer or in the meeting room. The stratum of responsibilities may bury your leisure time at the workplace, feels Ganesha.
